newsitem.title: POLAND: Bourse debut of Poland's Handlowy on June 26 or 30.
newsitem.headline: Bourse debut of Poland's Handlowy on June 26 or 30.

text.p: Poland's Bank Handlowy SA will start trading on the Warsaw bourse's main market on June 26 or June 30 and the bourse will choose the final date on Saturday, the bourse's president said on Friday.
"Two dates are proposed -- on June 26 or June 30 and we will pick one tomorrow....The June 30 date is more likely," Wieslaw Rozlucki told a news conference.

Handlowy's public offer of 38.35 million shares priced at 35 zlotys ended in a heavy oversubscription and the Warsaw bourse is due to formally allot the shares in the retail tranche at a special session on June 21.
Rozlucki said that after the session the bourse would also decide when continuous trade in Handlowy shares would start.
